These data were collected for internal monitoring and evaluation purposes. The scope of data collection therefore differed by country and by year based on internal needs.  

Survey questions were also not always uniform across countries.  For example the estimate plot size estimates in Rwanda pertain to the individual plot on which we harvested, whereas in Tanzania and Kenya the plot refers to all land area dedicated to that crop and field type (program land vs. non program land).  These differences are detailed in the variables description. 

Many of these data rely on self reports by farmers, which is inherently imprecise e.g. Variables like seed rate and fertilizer rate are comprised of self reported kgs applied divided by self reported acres, which can result in imprecise estimates.  However, harvest estimates are based on physically weighed harvests from 2 randomly placed boxes, and can be considered reliable.
